faq.a1: Yes. We ship greenhouse-grown plants carefully packed and guarantee live arrival for 30 days.
faq.a2: They catch small insects naturally. Indoors, they often catch enough on their own — no feeding required.
faq.q3: Do I need a green thumb?
faq.a3: No. Each order includes a care guide covering light, water, and humidity — it's easier than you think.
faq.q4: Which plant should I choose as a beginner?
faq.a4: Our Starter Kit is perfect for first-time growers. Venus Flytrap and Cape Sundew are also great options.
faq.a5: We ship worldwide. If your plant does not arrive alive, contact us within 30 days and we will make it right.
